_meta.description: Stage 2 (Trained) for the Anaplan Platform foundational journey. Six content blocks covering the platform domains: Architecture, Dimensions, Calculation Layer, UX, Data & Integrations, Admin & Maintenance. Mix of self-paced Academy courses and supplementary recordings. Heavier than Anaplan Overview Stage 2 — this is the technical foundation every Delivery and Pre-Sales resource builds on.
_meta.boundary_with_stage_3: End of Stage 2: resource has consumed all platform-domain content and has hands-on sandbox access ready for Stage 3 labs and certification. They have NOT been certified yet — Stage 3 covers labs + Anaplan Certified Solutions Associate (or equivalent) exam.

_note: Stage 2 task structure is FIXED. Asset content references the canonical Anaplan Academy curriculum where applicable.
name: Trained
description: Resource builds platform fluency across architecture, dimensions, calculation layer, UX, data/integrations, and admin/maintenance. Combination of Academy courses (Level 1 and Level 2 Model Builder) and supplementary recordings.

blocks.name: Architecture Foundations
blocks.description: Workspaces, models, environments (dev/test/prod), ALM (Application Lifecycle Management) basics.

blocks.name: Dimensions
blocks.description: Lists, hierarchies, time scales — the dimensional foundation that drives every model.

blocks.name: Calculation Layer
blocks.description: Modules, line items, formulas. The 'how' of Anaplan calculations.

blocks.name: User Experience & Pages
blocks.description: Anaplan UX (Pages), dashboards, action buttons, drill-through, mobile.

blocks.name: Data & Integrations
blocks.description: Data hubs, model-to-model imports, Anaplan Connect, CloudWorks, Anaplan API.

blocks.name: Admin, Security & Maintenance
blocks.description: Roles, selective access, model performance optimization, maintenance routines.

tasks.title: Anaplan Architecture Foundations
tasks.description: Recording covering workspaces, models, environment progression (dev/test/prod), and ALM (Application Lifecycle Management) basics. Anchors the rest of Stage 2 in the architectural mental model.

tasks.title: Level 1 Model Builder Academy course
tasks.description: Self-paced Academy course covering lists, hierarchies, time scales, modules, line items, and basic formulas. Includes practice exercises and a completion quiz. Covers blocks B and C foundationally; deeper content in Level 2.

tasks.title: Level 2 Model Builder Academy course
tasks.description: Self-paced Academy course covering advanced calculation patterns, complex formulas, summary methods, time-shifted calculations, and module performance considerations. Builds on Level 1.

tasks.title: Anaplan UX (Pages) design
tasks.description: Self-paced Academy course covering Anaplan Pages — board / worksheet / report page types, action buttons, contextual selectors, drill-through, and mobile responsiveness. Includes design-pattern guidance.

tasks.title: Data Hubs & Integration Patterns
tasks.description: Recording covering data hub architecture, model-to-model imports, Anaplan Connect / CloudWorks for batch integration, and Anaplan API basics. Concrete patterns for getting data into and out of Anaplan in real customer engagements.

tasks.title: Admin, Security & Maintenance Essentials
tasks.description: Recording covering workspace admin tasks, model roles vs page builder, selective access, common security pitfalls, model-size and performance monitoring, and routine maintenance practices. The 'what to do when the model is in production' content.
